-- CREATE VIEW CALENDAR


CREATE VIEW gold.calendar
AS
SELECT
    *
    FROM
        OPENROWSET(
            BULK 'https://adventureprojectstorage.blob.core.windows.net/silverlayer/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
            FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
        ) as QUER1
